title: 第4147章 功法适配 血衣尊者的特殊助力了第4146章 绘画记录 熵觉醒的探索印记
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
红光还在闪，警报声像锅里炒豆子似的噼啪炸个不停。方浩盯着那点幽蓝坐标，鼻尖掠过一丝说不清道不明的波动，像是旧棉袄上蹭了灶灰的味道，熟悉得让人挠心。
他没动。
倒不是怕了，是脑子转得比脚快——这玩意儿看着玄乎，可眼下最要命的不是解谜，是人。
探险队那帮小子站了一圈，脸色比炉渣还沉。灵气在经脉里跟冻住似的，走两步喘三下，有个新来的甚至扶着墙干呕，看样子连丹田都快结霜了。
“停。”方浩一抬手，声音不高，但压住了所有杂音，“谁也别往前挪半步。”
队伍立刻收住脚，没人吭声。刚才那一阵笑声、豪情、画里的热闹劲儿，全被地底深处那股阴风给吹散了。
方浩转身，看向角落里那个一直没说话的人。
血衣尊者靠墙站着，大红袍子一尘不染，袖口都没皱一下。他从头到尾没碰过画卷，也没问什么坐标的事，就像这事跟他八竿子打不着。
“你。”方浩指着他，“对歪门邪道的能量最熟，有没有法子？”
血衣尊者抬眼，眼神淡得像井水。他没反驳，也没冷笑，就那么看了方浩两息时间，忽然抬手。
一道血线自指尖射出，在空中划了个半圆，凝成一张极简的符阵。图案不复杂，像个歪歪扭扭的“回”字，中间多了一道逆旋的弧。
“照这个呼吸。”他说，“吸的时候慢半拍，引一丝地脉浊气进来，别怕脏，关键是用逆旋法逼出来——不是冲，是滑。”
话音落，他自己先盘膝坐下，闭眼调息。众人只见他胸口微微起伏，一圈暗红色的气流顺着经络游走一圈，最后从掌心推出一团黑雾，落地即散，闻着有点像烧焦的蚯蚓。
“谁来试试？”方浩环视一圈。
没人动。
不是不信，是魔修传功，听着就跟喝毒药一样。谁也不知道练完会不会晚上睁眼发现自己长角了。
方浩也不急。他从怀里摸出一颗灰扑扑的丸子，看卖相像饭团搓的，二话不说塞嘴里嚼了两下，咽下去。
“清火的。”他拍拍肚子，“上火了吃一颗，降燥。”
说完，他依着血衣尊者的法子开始调息。动作笨拙得像个初学者，但气息流转清晰可见，灵力在体内绕了一圈，稳稳落回丹田。
“他都敢试，咱们还怕啥？”有人嘀咕。

“就是，宗主要是变妖怪了，咱们集体辞职回家种地。”
笑声不大，但紧绷的肩松了。
一个队员壮着胆子照做。结果刚引气入体，脸就涨成了猪肝色，灵力卡在膻中穴那儿不上不下，疼得龇牙咧嘴。
血衣尊者睁开眼，走过去，手指一点他后颈：“不是用灵压推，是顺着那股闷劲滑进去。你当自己是油条，不是铁棍。”
content_en:
The red light was still flashing, and the alarm was crackling like beans in a pot. Fang Hao stared at the faint blue coordinates, and an indescribable wave passed through the tip of his nose, like the smell of stove ashes on an old cotton jacket, which was so familiar that it made people feel heartbroken.
He didn't move.
It's not that I'm scared, it's because my brain is spinning faster than my feet - this thing looks mysterious, but the most important thing right now is not the puzzle, but the people.
The boys from the expedition team stood in a circle, their faces darker than slag. The spiritual energy seemed to be frozen in the meridians. He took two steps and gasped three times. One newcomer even held the wall and retched. It looked like even his dantian was about to freeze.
"Stop." Fang Hao raised his hand, his voice was not loud, but he suppressed all the noise, "No one can move forward."
The team immediately stopped and no one said a word. The burst of laughter, pride, and excitement in the painting were all blown away by the dark wind deep underground.
Fang Hao turned around and looked at the silent man in the corner.
The blood-clothed venerable man stood against the wall. His red robe was spotless, and the cuffs were not wrinkled. He never touched the scroll from beginning to end, and never asked about the coordinates, as if it had nothing to do with him.
"You." Fang Hao pointed at him, "You are the most familiar with the energy of crooked ways. Do you have any ideas?"
The blood-clothed venerable raised his eyes, his eyes as pale as well water. He didn't refute or sneer, he just looked at Fang Hao for two breaths and then suddenly raised his hand.
A line of blood shot out from the fingertips, drawing a semicircle in the air and forming a simple talisman array. The pattern is not complicated, like a crooked word "Hui" with a counter-rotating arc in the middle.
"Breathe like this." He said, "Breathe slowly when you inhale, bringing in a trace of turbid Qi from the earth pulse. Don't be afraid of getting dirty. The key is to use counter-rotation to force it out - not rushing, but sliding."
After he finished speaking, he sat down cross-legged, closed his eyes and adjusted his breathing. Everyone saw his chest rise and fall slightly, and a circle of dark red air flowed along the meridians. Finally, a black mist was pushed out from the palm of his hand, which dispersed as soon as it hit the ground. It smelled a bit like burnt earthworms.
"Who will try?" Fang Hao looked around.
No one moved.
It’s not that I don’t believe it, it’s a demonic cultivator teaching me a skill, which sounds like drinking poison. No one knows if they will wake up at night and find that they have grown horns after practicing.
Fang Hao was not in a hurry. He took out a dusty ball from his arms and saw that it looked like a rice ball. Without saying anything, he stuffed it into his mouth, chewed it twice, and swallowed it.
"It clears away the internal heat." He patted his belly, "If you get internal heat, take one to reduce dryness."
After saying that, he started to adjust his breath according to the blood-clothed venerable's method. His movements were as clumsy as a beginner's, but his breath flow was clearly visible, and his spiritual power circled around his body before falling steadily back to his Dantian.
"He dares to try, so what are we afraid of?" someone murmured.
"That's right, the sect leader has turned into a monster. Let's all resign and go home to farm."
The laughter was not loud, but the tense shoulders relaxed.
One of the team members had the courage to do so. As a result, as soon as the Qi was introduced into the body, his face turned the color of pig liver, his spiritual energy was stuck in the Tanzhong point, and he grimaced in pain.
The blood-clothed venerable opened his eyes, walked over, and touched the back of his neck with his finger: "It's not pushing with spiritual pressure, but sliding in along with the tightness. You think you are a fried dough stick, not an iron rod."
